lavender-canvas.$description: Lavender Canvas — Page background, hero section wash, footer background — the base atmosphere that distinguishes Reclaim from generic white SaaS

white-surface.$description: White Surface — Card surfaces, product mockup containers, button text on dark fills — pure white provides the resting layer above the lavender canvas

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body copy and card text on light surfaces — sits just above pure black for slightly softer reading weight

slate.$description: Slate — Muted helper text, secondary descriptions, footer text — the workhorse for non-headline copy

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Subheadings and emphasized body — bridges Midnight Ink headings and Slate body text

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline dividers, decorative strokes, subtle separators

iris-violet.$description: Iris Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sapphire-violet.$description: Sapphire Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Soft tints for product card highlights, decorative violet washes, outlined button borders — the muted cousin of Iris Violet

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Disabled or secondary violet state, ghost button text on violet themes

indigo-depth.$description: Indigo Depth — Dark mode gradient anchor, deep accent for special promotional sections

focus-green.$description: Focus Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

mint-whisper.$description: Mint Whisper — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation

forest-edge.$description: Forest Edge — Dark green gradient stop for special promotional banners

brick.$description: Brick — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

poppins.$description: Exclusive brand typeface used for every text element. The 300-weight whisper at 70–90px for hero headlines is the signature move — most productivity apps use bold display weights, but Reclaim's thin Poppins headlines float above the page rather than punch through it. Letter-spacing is consistently tightened at -0.01em across all sizes, giving the rounded Poppins letterforms a slightly more compact, intentional feel rather than the default airy spacing.

inter.$description: Secondary fallback used only in 24 specific UI spots — effectively negligible. Treat as legacy or data-table context, not a design system font.
